items.title: Bitcoin climbs above $64,000 while most majors slip
items.snippet: Miners have cut their computing power by a fifth over three quarters to make room for AI, and Venice's token jumped 10% after the company said it crossed $100 million in annualised revenue.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо BTC -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: South Korea’s Jeonbuk Bank taps Ripple for cross-border payments
items.snippet: Ripple is bringing its cross-border payments platform to Jeonbuk Bank, but key details including its launch status and settlement asset remain undisclosed.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо XRP -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: Alleged $165M crypto Ponzi mastermind faces US charges after Fiji deportation
items.snippet: Prosecutors allege Edward Zimbardi collected crypto from thousands of investors, lost over $34 million on currency trades and spent at least $10 million personally.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: ‘Fabricated rumors’ about BitMart founder, Binance bStocks dominate: Asia Express
items.snippet: Binance’s bStocks are the second largest tokenized stock issuer just two months after launch, and BitMart’s internal feud erupts into the spotlight ahead of its closure
items.note: Позитивний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами.
